title: multi run research --dry-run estimates USD 0.42 for three Haiku pip agents that cost USD 2.69 to 3.05 in the 2026-10-28 records
goal: multi run research --dry-run --model research=haiku-5-5 prints an estimate within a factor of two of the recorded Haiku concurrent research records (USD 2.69 to 5.77): its research estimate, the mean cost of the repro area runs scaled by the input price ratio 0.05, prints USD 0.14 an agent, about a tenth of the recorded cost

gates.question: How does the multi run research estimate price a research agent whose model has recorded multi runs?
options: the mean cost of the model's recorded multi research agents, else the repro mean scaled by the input price ratio
the repro mean scaled by a per-model factor fitted to the multi records
the repro mean scaled by the input price ratio only
gates.recommendation: the mean cost of the model's recorded multi research agents, else the repro mean scaled by the input price ratio
gates.answer: the mean cost of the model's recorded multi research agents, else the repro mean scaled by the input price ratio
